title: Suspected meningitis

beats.text: NPC: waits for CT + LP first.
SIGMA: cultures, then IV antibiotics now.

caption:
Suspected bacterial meningitis and the LP will be delayed: take blood cultures and give IV antibiotics now. Don't wait.

Save this for the exam.

#EMREE #meningitis #emergencymedicine #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors

fact.claim: Suspected bacterial meningitis: if LP cannot be done promptly, take blood cultures and start IV antibiotics without waiting for LP/CT
fact.check: NICE NG240 Meningitis (bacterial) and meningococcal disease (2024)
